title: Apple Health and Health Connect sync
body: Import workouts and export weight. Manual re-entry of watch workouts is the main friction.
pm_note: Requires native shells; Capacitor config exists but no store builds.

title: Do not lose guest entries at sign-up
body: Only one of my nine guest entries synced. The rest vanished with a warning toast.
pm_note: syncGuestDataToAccount loops per-entry, swallows per-entry failures, then clears local storage regardless.

title: Offline logging with a sync queue
body: Gym has no signal. Let me log and have it sync when I am back online.
pm_note: Apollo uses network-only for daily log; no persisted cache or outbox.

title: Actually let me buy Premium
body: Upgrade button shows a coming soon toast. Take my money.
pm_note: handleUpgrade is a placeholder toast; no billing provider integrated.

title: Exercise history beyond seven days
body: Let me pick a month or a year. Seven days is not a history.
pm_note: Gated as premium ('exercise-history-full') but the premium path is unimplemented; API is date-scoped only.

title: Fix iPhone photo upload
body: Avatar upload from an iPhone fails. Screenshots from the same phone work.
pm_note: HEIC content type likely rejected by requestProfilePhotoUpload allowlist.

title: Workout reminder notifications
body: A nudge on my planned training days would keep my streak alive.
pm_note: No push infrastructure; web push possible without native shell.

title: Aggregate participation export for employers
body: Anonymised CSV of participation and adherence per cohort, monthly.
pm_note: Premium page advertises CSV/JSON export; nothing implemented. Enterprise contract dependency.

title: Dark mode contrast is too low
body: Purple on near-black fails to be readable. Numbers are the important part of the screen.
pm_note: variables.css deep purple dark mode; token contrast under 3:1 on key figures.

title: Custom activity types
body: Climbing, rowing, pickleball. Six standard activities is not enough.
pm_note: CustomActivityType exists in types and is gated premium; no UI to create one.

title: Weight trend chart
body: Plot weight over time with a moving average.
pm_note: HealthProfile stores a single current weightKg — no time series.

title: Accessible progress dashboard
body: VoiceOver announces the weekly progress ring as an empty group.
pm_note: WeeklySummary/StatGrid lack role/aria-valuenow; EAA exposure for EU corporate accounts.

title: Ship the analytics you advertise
body: Premium lists advanced analytics and insights. There is no analytics screen at all.
pm_note: featureGates declares 'analytics' premium; no route or page exists. Advertising risk.

title: Streaks and badges
body: Give me a streak counter and a weekly badge. It is why I open a tracker daily.
pm_note: No engagement loop beyond the dashboard.

title: SAML SSO
body: Security review requires SSO against our identity provider before general rollout.
pm_note: Cognito user pool supports SAML federation; not configured (social/enterprise logins descoped).

title: Publish iOS and Android apps
body: A web app cannot give me a home screen widget or reliable notifications.
pm_note: Capacitor 8 configured; no CI signing or store presence.

title: Imperial units (lb, ft/in, miles)
body: Let me pick a unit system once in settings and have every screen respect it. Storing metric underneath is fine, just stop making me convert.
pm_note: HealthProfile is heightCm/weightKg only; needs a preference field plus display conversion. Cheap and high volume.

title: Generate a training plan for me
body: Take my profile, my goal and what I have actually logged, and lay out the next few weeks including rest days. Let me regenerate it if it is too hard.
pm_note: Highest-vote request in the window. No plan entity in the schema at all. Natural fit for generation rather than a template library.

title: Weekly and monthly progress reports
body: A report for the last 7 days and the last month: total sessions, minutes, trend against the previous period, and something I can send to my coach.
pm_note: Requires a range query on the EXERCISE# sort key; exerciseEntries currently takes one required AWSDate.

title: Unit system per user for mixed-geography programmes
body: Our programme spans US and EU sites. Each employee should choose their own units without the programme admin configuring anything.
pm_note: Per-user preference, not per-tenant. Blocks Aurora renewal conversation.

title: Programme-level plan templates with per-employee adaptation
body: We want to seed a starting programme and have it adapt per participant based on what they log.
pm_note: Enterprise variant of PFR-0435. Do not build separately; make the generator accept a seed.

title: Explain my month in plain language
body: Numbers are fine but I want a couple of sentences telling me what actually changed and what to do about it.
pm_note: This is the narrative layer of the report, not a separate feature. Generated text over computed figures.
